session_1.speaker: Nadia
session_1.text: Omar! Guess what - I finally signed up for the pottery class at the community studio.

session_1.speaker: Omar
session_1.text: That's awesome, Nadia! You've been talking about pottery for months. When does it start?

session_1.speaker: Nadia
session_1.text: First class is next Tuesday evening. It runs for eight weeks.

session_1.speaker: Omar
session_1.text: Nice. I've been busy too - I adopted a grey tabby cat last weekend. Named him Biscuit.

session_1.speaker: Nadia
session_1.text: Biscuit! That's adorable. Is he settling in okay?

session_1.speaker: Omar
session_1.text: He hid under the couch for two days but now he owns the apartment.

session_2.speaker: Nadia
session_2.text: I made my first proper bowl in pottery class! It's lopsided but I love it.

session_2.speaker: Omar
session_2.text: Ha! Lopsided bowls have character. I have news too - I got promoted to senior data analyst at the logistics company.

session_2.speaker: Nadia
session_2.text: Congratulations! Does that mean more travel?

session_2.speaker: Omar
session_2.text: A bit. I'll be visiting the Rotterdam office in April for two weeks.

session_2.speaker: Nadia
session_2.text: Rotterdam in spring sounds lovely. Take pictures of the architecture for me.

session_3.speaker: Omar
session_3.text: Back from Rotterdam! The office visit went well and I tried herring from a street stall. Biscuit sulked the whole time I was gone, according to my sister.

session_3.speaker: Nadia
session_3.text: Poor Biscuit. While you were away I finished the pottery course - our final projects were glazed last week. I made a full dinner set, six plates and six bowls.

session_3.speaker: Omar
session_3.text: A whole dinner set! You went from lopsided bowl to production line in two months.

session_3.speaker: Nadia
session_3.text: I'm signing up for the intermediate wheel-throwing course in May.

qa.question: What is the name of Omar's cat?
What did Nadia make for her pottery final project?
qa.answer: A full dinner set with six plates and six bowls

qa.question: What job title did Omar hold when he traveled to Rotterdam?
How long after signing up for the pottery class did Nadia finish the course?
qa.answer: About three and a half months (signed up in early January, finished in late April)

qa.question: When did Omar adopt his cat?
What color is Nadia's car?
qa.adversarial_answer: Nadia never mentioned owning a car.
